status: M11 Stage 2, step 2.4c (Counting Hills), authored by the curriculum-expert on 2026-11-16. Host lines are plain drafts for the hebrew-text-editor. Only the Show of NUM-B-07 (trace) plays today; the others wait for the Show and lead players of number_line, give_n, count_tap, shop_pay and the share mode of sort_drag (step 2.1 for the templates the pilot did not need), or for Stage 3 (NUM-A-11 to A-14); a lesson whose Show waits stays a flat list (arc_build.py).
howToRead: As shape-forest.arc.json. Steps of the templates that have no Show player yet are written in the move words the player will need (the hand-off to the app-developer): number_line `hop` (one hop of that size from where the marker stands) and `point` (the host points to a tick and says its number) with the child's `place` (the frog put on a tick); count_tap `touch` (that many objects touched in one run of the hand, each counted aloud); give_n `move` (that many objects moved to the target in one run, counted aloud); shop_pay `coin` (one coin of that kind laid on the counter); sort_drag share `item` and `bin` (the card dealt to that bin).
A Show with `template: null` waits for a Stage 3 template; its lines and picture are the brief for it.

lessons: Together is the first item of the lesson's first skill, concrete first; a template with no lead player has lead 0 (the host says its line and the child does the whole item). Alone is the pool, concrete first, then pictures, then symbols.
